description: Always denies access. Used as safety net after pam_succeed_if to ensure no accidental fallthrough.
pam_stack_examples: auth [success=1 default=ignore] pam_succeed_if.so user = rescue service = login
auth requisite pam_deny.so (deny if not rescue user)

control_flags.requisite: Fail immediately and don't call further modules

notes: Simple module with no parameters. Always fails. Used as emergency stop in authentication flow. When used with pam_succeed_if, creates exclusive access rules.
